Fixtures for tests. Source: Met Éireann (https://data.gov.ie/en_GB/dataset/weather-warnings), Met Éireann Custom Open Data Licence (CC BY 4.0 based). Unmodified.
- met-eireann-warning_ALL.sample.json: official JSONExample.zip, warning_ALL.json (downloaded 04/11/2026; example data dated Sept 2026).
- met-eireann-warning_ALL.live-2026-11-04.json: live feed captured 04/11/2026 (marine small-craft warnings).

News fixtures (04/11/2026, unmodified apart from keeping only the fields the skill reads for the HN files):
- wikipedia-current-events-2026-11-03.wikitext, wikipedia-current-events-2026-11-04-stub.wikitext: wikitext of "Portal:Current events" day pages, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Current_events . Text by Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
- hn-front_page.live-2026-11-04.json, hn-search-ai.live-2026-11-04.json: responses from https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search (Hacker News data; titles belong to their submitters).

GitHub fixtures (04/11/2026, unmodified responses from the public REST API, google-ai-edge/gallery, an Apache-2.0 repository): github-repo.json, github-release-latest.json, github-commits.json, github-issues.json.

Email addresses in the github-*.json fixtures were replaced with redacted@example.invalid before publishing; nothing else was changed.
